answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the sonnet of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. A dune of per-task receipts records who did what, and the sparrow of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, published publicly on failure, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
